regions.merged_text: My Dear Friends: God bless you and yours. Many thanks indeed for your charitable favor noted yesterday. I came just in nice time - especially the smaller cheque - to enroll quite a number of my friends in the Ser Mass Assoc'n for a Christmas gifte. - a double, tripple charity. Thinking you were down in Texas for the Winter I addressed a letter to you only last week - to Palner Hotel Mc Allen Texas - the address as - indicated on the baskets of fine fruit that came to us in your name - and for which I want to thank you again - for the twofine baskets of delicious fruit. You will very likely receive the letter forwarded withe relics of V.Nother fary of Jesus, of Agreda, which had inclosed.
